digest.component_or_area: LLM model class resolution for verifier paths
propositions: Three independent verifier code paths select a model by comparing cfg.model to a constant (DEFAULT_MODEL equality), breaking when the provider changes the default or an operator configures a non-default model
The code-review.yaml verify step declares no model: key and falls through to cfg.model (frontier), losing the temperature: 0 determinism setting intended for greedy Pass-2 verification
Verifier paths must uniformly resolve the reserved class name 'standard' through a single resolve_model_string() vocabulary function, replacing the broken equality tests with class-name indirection
The model_ladder rungs used for escalation order and context-window sizing have a dual role that cannot be split into class names without breaking the window-token lookup logic
